vision.name: Red Amplified Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your Styled energy attacks cost -1 stage (this effect cannot lower a cost to 0). Whenever a Drill you control leaves play, Rejuvenate 1.
[Instant] POWER: Use when your MP changes levels. Choose a Drill you control. It cannot be discarded or destroyed this turn.
POWER: Raise or lower a player's anger 1. Gain X stages and your next Styled attack this combat deals +X life cards. X = your current anger level.
